description: Whether to always prefer ternary, or only for single-line expressions.

checkVaryingBase.description: Also report expressions that differ only by the base of a call or member access, whose minimization moves the ternary into the base (`(test ? a : b).foo`).

checkComputedMemberAccess.description: Whether to also report static property or method name differences on a shared receiver, including member chains, requiring computed member access.

checkNestedTernaries.description: Whether to report merges whose conditions or values contain ternary expressions.
